LUNA_API_KEY: Set only on the internal analytics deployment for the OpenAI Decisions shadow experiment; never documented for operators. The provider is removed, so the key has nothing to authenticate.
LUNA_MODEL: Model name for the removed OpenAI Decisions provider; set only on the internal analytics deployment and never documented for operators.
LUNA_TIMEOUT_MS: Timeout for the removed OpenAI Decisions provider; set only on the internal analytics deployment and never documented for operators.
LUNA_SHADOW_ENABLED: Toggled the removed shadow comparison between Jev and OpenAI Decisions; set only on the internal analytics deployment and never documented for operators.
SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ENABLED: Self-hosted operators set it to turn on service accounts. Service accounts are now always on for licensed instances, so the variable has no effect and nothing breaks when it is left set or removed.
CHANGE_CHART_EXPLORE_ENABLED: Cloud and self-hosted operators set it to enable the Change explore action. The action is now always available to chart authors on the chart page, so leaving or removing this variable preserves its enabled behaviour.
EDIT_YAML_IN_UI_ENABLED: Turned on the edit-yaml-in-ui source editor drawer; set only for internal testing and never documented for operators. The drawer and its gated endpoints are removed, so the variable has nothing to enable.
E2B_PYTHON_WARM_TEMPLATE_NAME: Set only by internal composer experiment deployments since 3.53.1; mentioned only in the sandbox README, never in operator docs. The warm build now ships as the default lightdash-python-runner template, so nothing breaks without this setting.
E2B_PYTHON_WARM_TEMPLATE_TAG: Set only by internal composer experiment deployments since 3.53.1; mentioned only in the sandbox README, never in operator docs. The warm build now ships as the default lightdash-python-runner template, so nothing breaks without this setting.
AI_CODING_AGENT_MAX_REPO_SIZE_MB: Set by developers for the internal general-purpose coding-agent experiment and not documented for operators. That experiment is removed, so this unused setting no longer configures a sandbox or run.
E2B_CODING_AGENT_TEMPLATE_NAME: Set by developers for the internal general-purpose coding-agent experiment and not documented for operators. That experiment is removed, so this unused setting no longer configures a sandbox or run.
E2B_CODING_AGENT_TEMPLATE_TAG: Set by developers for the internal general-purpose coding-agent experiment and not documented for operators. That experiment is removed, so this unused setting no longer configures a sandbox or run.
METRIC_DASHBOARD_FILTERS_ENABLED: Self-hosted operators set it to turn on the beta metric dashboard filter UI. The feature is now on for everyone, so nothing breaks when the variable is left set or removed.
DBT_CROSS_SOURCE_MAX_PASSES: Set for the cross-source dbt refs experiment, which is off by default and is now removed. Independent source compiles never read this setting, so they keep their existing behaviour without it.
DBT_SOURCE_PREPARE_TIMEOUT_MS: Set for the cross-source dbt refs experiment, which is off by default and is now removed. Independent source compiles never read this setting, so they keep their existing behaviour without it.
DBT_SOURCE_LS_TIMEOUT_MS: Set for the cross-source dbt refs experiment, which is off by default and is now removed. Independent source compiles never read this setting, so they keep their existing behaviour without it.
DBT_CROSS_SOURCE_RESOLUTION_TIMEOUT_MS: Set for the cross-source dbt refs experiment, which is off by default and is now removed. Independent source compiles never read this setting, so they keep their existing behaviour without it.
ORGANIZATION_WAREHOUSE_CREDENTIALS_ENABL: Self-hosted operators set it to turn on organization warehouse credentials; never documented for operators. The flag it fed has no readers since the credentials UI was removed, and the credentials API and project linking do not check it, so nothing changes when it is left set or removed.
SANDBOX_AGENT_ONBOARDING_DOCKER_IMAGE: Local development override for the onboarding agent sandbox image; never documented for operators. The onboarding agent is removed, so nothing reads it and leaving it set has no effect.
E2B_AGENT_ONBOARDING_TEMPLATE_NAME: Selected the sandbox template for the onboarding agent; never documented for operators. The onboarding agent is removed, so nothing reads it and leaving it set has no effect.
E2B_AGENT_ONBOARDING_TEMPLATE_TAG: Selected the sandbox template version for the onboarding agent; never documented for operators. The onboarding agent is removed, so nothing reads it and leaving it set has no effect.
GROUPS_ENABLED: Self-hosted operators and Cloud Pro and Enterprise plans set it to turn on groups. Groups are always on since 3.179.0 and that release already ignored the variable, so leaving it set or removing it changes nothing.
AUTOCOMPLETE_CACHE_ENABLED: Self-hosted operators set it to cache filter autocomplete values. Filter autocomplete in the app already uses each project's results cache, and the remaining field value search API now follows the same project setting. Leaving the variable set has no effect; searches still return values, uncached until results caching is turned on in project settings.
OPENAI_ZERO_DATA_RETENTION: Self-hosted operators set it when their OpenAI account or gateway enforces Zero Data Retention. Every OpenAI Responses request is now stateless (store: false, with encrypted reasoning), so the variable has no effect and nothing breaks when it is left set or removed.
AI_EMBEDDING_ENABLED: Self-hosted operators set it to turn on AI agent verified answers. The feature is removed, so the variable has nothing to enable and nothing breaks when it is left set or removed.
AI_DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER: Self-hosted operators set it to choose the embedding provider for AI agent verified answers. The feature and its embeddings are removed, so nothing reads it and leaving it set has no effect.
AI_VERIFIED_ANSWER_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD: Self-hosted operators set it to tune how closely a question had to match an AI agent verified answer. The feature is removed, so nothing reads it and leaving it set has no effect.
OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL: Self-hosted operators set it to pick the OpenAI embedding model for AI agent verified answers. The feature and its embeddings are removed; chat models keep using OPENAI_MODEL_NAME, so leaving it set has no effect.
AZURE_EMBEDDING_DEPLOYMENT_NAME: Self-hosted operators set it to name the Azure embedding deployment for AI agent verified answers. The feature and its embeddings are removed; chat keeps using AZURE_AI_DEPLOYMENT_NAME, so leaving it set has no effect.
BEDROCK_EMBEDDING_MODEL: Self-hosted operators set it to pick the Bedrock embedding model for AI agent verified answers. The feature and its embeddings are removed; chat keeps using BEDROCK_MODEL_NAME, so leaving it set has no effect.
